author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices a swaying one-two-three beat, finding C, echoing short patterns, this way and that, and taking turns as leader and copycat.

classes.title: This way and that way
classes.goal: Hear the whole song and sway to its one-two-three beat together.

mathTarget.parentLine: Beats come in little groups of three: one, two, three

classes.parentPrompt: Sway left on 'this way', right on 'that way'; say 'one, two, three' softly.
classes.childAction: Sway this way and that way with the song.
classes.bridge: This way is the left side of the piano; that way is the right.

intro.caption: Sway like a lassie
intro.parentCue: sway left, then right, with the song

intro.caption: One, two, three, sway!
intro.parentCue: Count three softly, then sway the other way

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: swaying to a one-two-three beat.

classes.title: One, two, three, tap
classes.goal: Tap one steady tap on every beat while the grown-up plays the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each beat, counting one, two, three

classes.parentPrompt: Count 'one, two, three' aloud and tap your child's hand on each number.
classes.childAction: Tap any key on every beat: one, two, three.
classes.bridge: Each group of three is a little twirl: one big step, two small steps.

intro.caption: Tap with the circle
intro.parentCue: Count one, two, three out loud together

games.caption: Twirl taps: one, two, three
games.parentCue: Count each group of three with your child

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: tapping the beat in groups of three.

classes.title: Find the lassie's C
classes.goal: Find C on the piano by touch, just left of the two black keys.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the two black keys as a signpost to find C

classes.parentPrompt: Touch the two black keys together, then slide left to the white key C.
classes.childAction: Find two black keys, slide left, press C like a button.
classes.bridge: Two black keys are a little door; C waits just to the left of it.

intro.caption: Where does C live?
intro.parentCue: Touch the two black keys together first

games.caption: C, C, C: one, two, three
games.parentCue: Count out loud with each press

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding C by the two black keys.

classes.title: Copy the lassie
classes.goal: Listen to a short 3 note call from the song, then copy it back.

mathTarget.parentLine: Holding three sounds in mind, then playing them back

classes.parentPrompt: Play the call like a leader, then wait with hands in your lap.
classes.childAction: You are the copycat: listen, then play it back the same.
classes.bridge: In the lassie game you copy the leader; here you copy the keys.

intro.caption: Listen, then echo me
intro.parentCue: Do a silly move; let your child copy it

games.caption: Peek up: G, A, G
games.parentCue: Pop your head up on A

games.caption: Dip down: F, E, F
games.parentCue: Dip your head down on E

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening and copying short tunes.

classes.title: One high, two low
classes.goal: Echo the 'this way and that way' pattern and feel it come twice.

mathTarget.parentLine: A group of three: one high note, then two low ones

classes.parentPrompt: Lean right on E, left on the two Cs; then do it once more.
classes.childAction: Play E, then C, C. Then the same again.
classes.bridge: E leans that way, C leans this way: one, then two.

intro.caption: Listen, then echo me
intro.parentCue: Lean one way, then the other, together

games.caption: This way: E, C, C
games.parentCue: Say 'one, two, three' with the three notes

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing a pattern of one and two.

classes.title: Wait for your C
classes.goal: Wait and play C at the right moments while the grown-up plays the rest.

mathTarget.parentLine: Waiting for your turn, then playing exactly then

classes.parentPrompt: Play the blue keys, including the low Gs; nod just before each coral C.
classes.childAction: Hands in your lap, then play C when it lights up.
classes.bridge: C ends each 'lassie' line, like landing after a twirl.

intro.caption: Wait for your C
intro.parentCue: hands in laps until the coral C lights

games.caption: Find your C
games.parentCue: Point to the key, then let them press

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: waiting for your turn, then playing C.

classes.title: Leader and copycat
classes.goal: Play the whole song together, each with your own notes, on a shared beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two players keeping the same steady beat

classes.parentPrompt: Nod the beat before you start; keep playing even if a note is missed.
classes.childAction: Play your notes and sway along with your grown-up.
classes.bridge: One leads, one follows, and the song keeps both in step.

intro.caption: Play it together
intro.parentCue: Nod one, two, three together before you start

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing together on one shared beat.

classes.title: Teddy leads the dance
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy, then copy teddy's silly move and bow.

mathTarget.parentLine: The 'did you ever see' line keeps coming back

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy facing the piano; after the last note, make teddy wiggle, and copy.
classes.childAction: Play for teddy, then copy teddy's silly dance and bow.
classes.bridge: The lassie line comes back again and again, like a dance that circles round.

intro.caption: A song for teddy
intro.parentCue: Sit teddy facing the piano to watch

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.
